findings.title: Confirm cypress-io/github-action v7 still accepts the inputs this step passes
findings.body: The step now pins `cypress-io/github-action@v7` (a major bump from v6). The only change in this part is the version tag; the `with:` block (`install`, `browser`, `wait-on`, `working-directory`) is unchanged at .github/workflows/js-ci.yml:270-274. The PR body is only "Bump cypress-io/github-action from 6 to 7" with no release notes, and the action's v7 `action.yml` is not in this repository, so I could not check whether any of these inputs were renamed or removed, or whether the runner's Node runtime changed. If an input was dropped, Cypress would not start with the intended settings (for example, it would run from the wrong directory) and the admin-ui-e2e matrix jobs would fail. That failure is visible: the `check` job at .github/workflows/js-ci.yml:296-313 needs admin-ui-e2e and would fail too. Worth checking the v7 release notes against these four inputs before merge, or confirming that the CI run for this PR exercises the Cypress step successfully.

verification.reason: The step does pin cypress-io/github-action@v7 and passes the unchanged inputs install, browser, wait-on and working-directory. The action's v7 action.yml and release notes aren't in the repository, so I can't confirm or rule out from the code whether v7 still accepts these inputs.

summary: Reviewed the only file in this part, .github/workflows/js-ci.yml. The change bumps the cypress-io/github-action step in the admin-ui-e2e job from @v6 to @v7 (line 269), and nothing else changes. The action is used only at that one location. The repository has no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or ADRs that bear on pinning, and the other workflow actions are pinned by major tag, so the tag style is consistent. I could not read the v7 action.yml from here, so I could not confirm that its inputs and runtime still match what the step passes. I raised that as one question at consider severity. The check job would surface any breakage in CI.
